{{Otheruses|Life's Memories}}
'''''Life's Memories''''' was a paper written by [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]] dealing with the nature of [[Death/Legends|death]] and its relationship to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref>''[[Life's Memories]]''</ref> It was released in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and due to its short length and readability, it was widely discussed by the citizens of the star system.<ref name="Trouble Follows Us">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030717trouble|text=Trouble Follows Us}}</ref>
